Why Homeowners Choose Us

Better than the rest, on the details that matter

Plenty of tilers can lay a floor. Fewer show up when they say they will, cut stone to a hairline, and stand behind the waterproofing underneath.

01

Precision craftsmanship

Tight, level grout lines and clean mitred edges — the finish that separates a good bathroom from a great one, checked at every stage.

02

Licensed & fully insured

Compliant waterproofing and documented cover on every job, so there's nothing left to chance behind the tiles.

03

Premium materials only

Natural stone, marble and porcelain sourced from suppliers we trust — nothing that looks tired in five years.

04

Dylan, on your job

No handing your renovation off to an unknown sub-contractor — you deal directly with Dylan from quote to final clean-up.

05

On time, on budget

A clear written quote before we start, and a realistic timeline we actually stick to — no surprise call-backs for extra cost.

06

Local reputation

Built entirely on referrals and repeat clients across Newcastle and Port Stephens — the portfolio speaks for itself.

What We Do

Tiling and stonework, done properly

From a single ensuite to a full outdoor entertaining area — every service below is handled in-house, start to finish.

Interior

Bathroom Tiling & Renovations

Full bathroom strip-outs and retiles, floor-to-ceiling, with waterproofing done to code and finished to a showroom standard.

Material

Natural Stone Installation

Marble, travertine and sandstone, cut and laid with the patience these materials demand — for feature walls, floors and vanities.

Outdoor

Paving & Alfresco Areas

Crazy paving, stepping paths and outdoor living spaces that hold their colour and grip through Hunter weather.

Wet Areas

Pool Tiling & Coping

Precision-set pool interiors and coping edges, laid dead level and finished with a slip-safe surface.

Structural

Waterproofing

Australian Standard-compliant membrane work on every wet area — the part you never see, done right the first time.

Feature

Feature Walls & Custom Stonework

Arched niches, fluted profiles and statement stone walls built around your design, not a catalogue template.
